''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story: Tales from Vandor]]'' is presented as an [[in-universe]] [[Midnight's book|book]] [[Author|written]] by [[Tivoche Bilure|Midnight]] that mentions [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] losing the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' to [[Han Solo]] in a game of [[sabacc]] and that is also set prior to the former becoming the [[Baron Administrator]] of [[Cloud City]]. ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the sabacc game between Calrissian and Solo to [[10 BBY]]. Additionally, Calrissian becomes Baron Administrator at some point after the flashback events of [[Halcyon Legacy 4|''Halcyon Legacy'' 4]] and [[Standard year|years]] prior to the events of ''[[The Empire Strikes Back: So You Want to Be a Jedi?]]'', which ''Timelines'' dates to approximately [[1 ABY]] and [[3 ABY]], respectively. Therefore, Midnight's [[book]] must have been authored at some point between 10 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]] and approximately 1 ABY.<noinclude>
